claim: When you turn on the Advanced mode of Database Insights while creating a DB instance or Multi-AZ DB cluster, the retention period must be 15 months in the console, and at least 465 days with the create-db-instance or create-db-cluster AWS CLI command.

evidence.quote: To turn on Database Insights, the retention period must be at least 465 days.
The retention period must be 15 months for the Advanced mode of Database Insights.
**To turn on the Advanced mode of Database Insights when creating a DB instance or Multi-AZDB cluster using the console**

qualifiers.scope: per DB instance or Multi-AZ DB cluster, when created with Advanced mode
qualifiers.condition: when the DB instance or Multi-AZ DB cluster is created with the Advanced mode of Database Insights
